chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah from one of his companions from Aban from Abd al-Rahman ibn Sayyabah from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Place the deceased in the grave with a gentle placing.

key_terms.سَلَّ: To place or lay down gently/carefully

ai.seo_question: How should the deceased be placed in the grave according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) emphasizes the physical gentleness required when lowering the deceased into the grave, reflecting the broader Shia emphasis on dignified and respectful burial rites. The instruction to 'pull gently' (salla) contrasts with hasty or rough handling, underscoring the continuity of care for the body even after death, a practice rooted in the Prophet's traditions and elaborated upon by later jurists in the context of *janazah* procedures.
